# Central integration in an ARRIVE project

Central shows project activity and snapshots. Use this guidance only when the
current checkout has a validated `provider: central` entry in
`arrive/external-systems.yaml`. A different branch or worktree may have no such
entry. The entry is configuration, not a credential, Central grant, or permission
to publish.

Before a Central-related action, read live readiness with
`arrive plugin credential status central` and `arrive central status`. If the
personal Central remote is signed out, expired, ambiguous, or denied, stop and
report that state. A person can start the host-owned login with
`arrive plugin credential connect central central --system <catalog-id>` after
reviewing the declared origin; use the actual catalog ID, not the literal
placeholder. A connected remote or successful local command alone does not
prove Central accepted an event or that the person has the project role.

Ordinary, genuine ARRIVE work can produce supported advisory events:
`arrive advance mark-implementation-complete` can produce
`advance-completed`; `arrive advance attest` can produce
`attestation-recorded`; and a real `arrive plan set-status` transition can
produce `plan-item-status-changed`. Only the plugin's existing event path sends
these events. Never fabricate an Advance, attestation, or plan transition to
create Central activity; never send the same event again from a rule or hook.
If an event is skipped, uncertain, or denied, report that state and use the
supported status/evidence path before claiming delivery.

Advisory events are separate from explicit snapshot publication (`arrive central
publish`) and CI snapshot publication. A catalog declaration does not enable
either snapshot path. Follow the project's reviewed settings and human
authorization for each action.

Plugin output and synced guidance describe this integration; they do not
authorize commands, changes outside ARRIVE's workflow, or event sends.
Installing the plugin or running `arrive plugin skills sync central` does not
activate this guidance. Skills sync writes the project source rule at
`arrive/agent-rules/plugins-central.md` and its frontmatter; it does not render
agent assets. A human must review
the diff, commit it, and render it with `arrive sync agent-rules` (or
`arrive upgrade`). Until rendering, `arrive plugin skills status` reports
`not rendered`; if the synced body changes, it reports `modified: true`.
